parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json;const d=input.deal??input;const lead_id=d.lead_id??null,deal_id=d.deal_id??null,property_id=d.property_id??null;const signature_status=String(d.signature_status??d.execution_status??"").toLowerCase();const agreement_type=String(d.agreement_type??d.contract_type??"").trim();const contract_price=Number(d.contract_price??d.accepted_price??NaN);const executed_at=d.executed_at??d.signature_completed_at??null;const closing_date=d.closing_date??d.target_closing_date??null;const seller=d.seller??{};const buyer=d.buyer??{};const blockers=Array.isArray(d.blockers)?d.blockers:[];let state="blocked",route="WF-126",reason="Transaction readiness is not authorized.";if(!lead_id||!deal_id||!property_id||!agreement_type||!Number.isFinite(contract_price)){reason="Missing executed agreement identity, agreement type, or contract price.";}else if(!["executed","signed","completed"].includes(signature_status)){reason="Executed signature evidence is not confirmed.";}else if(!executed_at){reason="Missing execution timestamp/evidence.";}else if(!seller.name&&!seller.full_name&&!d.seller_name){reason="Seller identity is missing.";}else if(!closing_date){reason="Target closing date is missing.";}else if(blockers.length){reason="Unresolved blockers prevent transaction launch.";}else{state="transaction_ready";route="WF-204";reason="Executed agreement is validated and transaction is ready for closing coordination.";}return[{json:{workflow:"WF-223",lead_id,deal_id,property_id,agreement_type,contract_price,signature_status,executed_at,closing_date,seller,buyer,blockers,state,route,reason,requires_human_review:true}}];
